## Summary

Describe what this Pull Request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Calculation change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Accessibility / UI
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance

## Validation

Explain how the change was tested.

- [ ] Tested in a modern desktop browser
- [ ] Tested responsive/mobile behavior when relevant
- [ ] Existing Skyline calculations still work
- [ ] Existing QRD 1D calculations still work
- [ ] Print/PDF output still works when relevant
- [ ] PWA/offline behavior was not unintentionally broken

## Calculation changes

If this changes formulas or algorithms, document the formula, units, assumptions and at least one independently checkable example.

## Screenshots / examples

Add screenshots, PDFs or before/after examples when useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications
- [ ] User-facing documentation was updated when necessary
- [ ] No theoretical acoustic estimate is presented as guaranteed real-world performance
